description: Two copies of the envelope generator from the Buchla Easel. Each has an attack, a hold and a decay, and runs as a repeating cycle when its end of cycle output is patched back to its gate input

params.text: The rise time, from 2ms to 10 seconds
How long the envelope holds at 10V once the attack is over, from 2ms to 10 seconds; it does nothing outside transient mode
The fall time, from 2ms to 10 seconds
Starts the envelope of that section by hand
Puts that envelope in sustained mode, where the gate input holds it at its top
Puts that envelope in transient mode, where a trigger runs the attack, then the hold, then the decay

inputs.text: Starts the envelope; a gate in sustained mode, where the envelope holds at its top for as long as the gate is high, and a trigger in transient mode
A voltage moving the rise time of that section
A voltage moving the hold time of that section
A voltage moving the fall time of that section

outputs.text: Sends a 1ms pulse each time the envelope finishes a cycle; patching it back to the gate input of that section makes the envelope repeat

menu: Restart from ZERO on Retrig — starts the envelope from 0V on a new trigger instead of from the level it had reached
